code = r'''
import numpy as np
from scipy.special import erf
gelu=lambda x: 0.5*x*(1+erf(x/np.sqrt(2)))
R=np.sqrt(768.)
def fit_kernel(E, lab, tr, a=2.0, t=0.0, lam=0.5, rho=1.0):
    """Fit closed-form ridge on [gelu(a*cos-ish + t) to centers, rho*Z/R]. Returns dict of params."""
    mu=E[tr].mean(0); sd=E[tr].std(0)+1e-6
    Z=(E-mu)/sd
    C=Z[tr]/np.linalg.norm(Z[tr],axis=1,keepdims=True)
    F=np.concatenate([gelu(a*(Z@C.T)/R+t), rho*Z/R],1)
    Ftr=F[tr]; m=Ftr.mean(0); Y=np.eye(8)[lab[tr]]-1/8
    Wt=np.linalg.solve((Ftr-m).T@(Ftr-m)+lam*np.eye(F.shape[1]),(Ftr-m).T@Y)
    scores=(F-m)@Wt
    return dict(mu=mu,sd=sd,C=C,a=a,t=t,rho=rho,Wt=Wt,m=m,scores=scores)
def build_layer11_ffn(p, Gamma=1e4, alpha=0.05, save=None):
    """Write FFN of layer 11 + pooler + classifier implementing score = (phi - m) @ Wt."""
    mu,sd,C,a,t,rho,Wt,m=p['mu'],p['sd'],p['C'],p['a'],p['t'],p['rho'],p['Wt'],p['m']
    nc=C.shape[0]; assert nc+16<=3072
    W1=np.zeros((3072,768)); b1=np.zeros(3072)
    # center units: preact = a*<C_i,(x-mu)/sd>/R + t
    W1[:nc]=a*C/sd[None,:]/R; b1[:nc]=t-a*(C@(mu/sd))/R
    # linear part: lin_k(x) = sum_d Wt_lin[d,k]*rho*(x_d-mu_d)/sd_d/R
    Wl=Wt[nc:]                      # [768,8]
    A=(rho/R)*(Wl/sd[:,None]).T     # [8,768]
    c=-(A@mu)                       # [8]
    W1[nc:nc+8]=A; b1[nc:nc+8]=c
    W1[nc+8:nc+16]=-A; b1[nc+8:nc+16]=-c
    # class directions v_k: orthonormal, zero-mean: (e_{2k}-e_{2k+1})/sqrt2 using dims 0..15
    V=np.zeros((8,768))
    for k in range(8): V[k,2*k]=1/np.sqrt(2); V[k,2*k+1]=-1/np.sqrt(2)
    # score_k = sum_i Wt[i,k]*phi_i + (u_k - u'_k) - m@Wt
    W2=np.zeros((768,3072))
    Bk=np.zeros((3072,8)); Bk[:nc]=Wt[:nc]; Bk[nc:nc+8]=np.eye(8); Bk[nc+8:nc+16]=-np.eye(8)
    W2[:]=Gamma*(V.T@Bk.T)
    const=-(m@Wt)      # [8]  (lin part centering: m for lin features = mean of rho*Z/R over train)
    b2=Gamma*(V.T@const)
    Wp=np.zeros((768,768)); Wp[:8]=alpha*V; bp=np.zeros(768)
    Wc=np.zeros((8,768)); Wc[np.arange(8),np.arange(8)]=1.0; bc=np.zeros(8)
    out={'bert.encoder.layer.11.intermediate.dense.weight':W1,'bert.encoder.layer.11.intermediate.dense.bias':b1,
         'bert.encoder.layer.11.output.dense.weight':W2,'bert.encoder.layer.11.output.dense.bias':b2,
         'bert.pooler.dense.weight':Wp,'bert.pooler.dense.bias':bp,'classifier.weight':Wc,'classifier.bias':bc}
    return {k:v.astype(np.float32) for k,v in out.items()}
'''
